report_name: Trezor Customer Data Exposed in Shipping Partner Breach

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromised Trezor's third-party shipping and logistics provider, ShipMonk, to gain access to customer data.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Attackers accessed and exfiltrated a database belonging to ShipMonk that contained Trezor customer order details and PII.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The exfiltrated customer PII enables threat actors to conduct highly targeted phishing, smishing, or vishing attacks to trick users into revealing their wallet recovery seeds.

campaigns.name: Trezor Shipping Partner Breach
campaigns.description: A supply chain attack targeting Trezor's shipping partner, ShipMonk, resulting in the exfiltration of personal data for approximately 13,689 Trezor customers between May and August 2026.
campaigns.objective: Exfiltrate PII of cryptocurrency hardware wallet owners for future targeted phishing attacks.

identities.name: Trezor
identities.description: A manufacturer of cryptocurrency hardware wallets whose customer data was exposed via a breach at its third-party shipping partner, ShipMonk.

identities.name: ShipMonk
identities.description: Trezor's third-party shipping and logistics provider whose systems were compromised, leading to the exposure of Trezor customer data.

identities.name: Trezor Customers
identities.description: A group of approximately 13,689 customers of the Trezor hardware wallet whose PII (names, addresses, emails, phone numbers) was exposed in the ShipMonk data breach.

infrastructure.name: ShipMonk Customer Database
infrastructure.description: The compromised database at ShipMonk containing PII and order information for Trezor customers.

indicators.name: Potential Trezor Phishing Domain
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Potential Trezor Phishing Domain DNS Query
id: 2a8b3c1d-e4f5-4a8b-9c1d-2e3f4a5b6c7d
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to potential look-alike domains used for phishing Trezor customers, as mentioned in hunting hints following a data breach.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/trezor-discloses-customer-data-breach-via-shipping-partner-shipmonk/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
tags:
  - attack.t1566
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'trezor-support.com'
      - 'trezor-verify.io'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries for potential typosquatted domains that could be used to phish Trezor customers following the ShipMonk data breach.
